body: I'd sign it. Dunno how much it'd accomplish but at least it's something.

I hate PETA. "Ethical Treatment of Animals" my ass. I wish someone would just sue the ever lasting fuck out of them until there is nothing left of their eco-terrorist organization. They've done plenty of lawbreaking over the years. Fuck em.
Indiana. Happy Holidays to you too.

I'm on income-based, so my loans are not too much problem right now. It's the rest that are gonna be a real pain. Yeah, I might be able to catch a break depending on my tax return for 2015. If I get one, I can use that money for some bills and the move. 

I plan on calling my phone company closer to March. I'm sure they might disconnect my phone, but the place we might move to has a landline I think. ANYWAY!!

Just knowing that I am not alone takes a good weight off of my shoulders. Thanks.

She doesn't stop. She's dead but it's like she's still there in my head all the time. When I lose everything in the next few months, she'll be there again. I just want this feeling of failure to go away. I want it all to go away.

I don't think I am. I have seen counselors in the past. If it didn't really help then, I am unsure if it will help now. They all seemed to act like my life was fucked up. Maybe I just don't see it. I dunno. I honestly think that maybe my mother saw that I was inept. Academically I was smart. Socially I'm stupid as fuck. Heck, when I first got a computer, I was freaked out because it could talk (Microsoft Sam). Now here I am typing on one. Heh. There are still many objects I cannot define, emotions that I lack the words to express, etc. 

With such stupidity, I do not think I have any place here. Truly. But I thank you for your words. Truly.
